name: The Sling and The Stone™
detailed_description:
The Sling and The Stone™

From nothing… to legend.
You begin with nothing but stones. No name. No weapons. No army.
Just a sling… and a burning purpose.

The Sling and The Stone is a single-player action-adventure game where you rise from a humble stone maker to a warrior feared by demons. Fight to rescue your brother and save your village from the clutches of a cursed land ruled by darkness.

But this isn’t just about survival. It’s about revenge, rescue, and ultimately discovering your true destiny.

What Awaits You:

  • A Hero’s Journey
    Start as a nobody. Grow into a warrior. End as something far greater.

  • Rescue & Revenge
    Save your brother and the captured villagers. Bring them to a hidden sanctuary. Destroy everything that stands in your way.

  • Powerful Sling Combat
    Craft and hurl special stones that pierce, burn, or even summon divine help. Every shot is a step toward justice.

  • A Final Encounter That Changes Everything

    Just when the enemy seems unstoppable, the hero meets someone greater than all, a mysterious force that steps in to help turn the tide.

    Who is He?

    That moment will define everything.

Why You'll Love It

This is not just a fight, it’s a transformation.
You’ll go from hunted to hunter, from a helpless brother to a warrior capable of turning fate itself. And when all hope seems lost, something beyond human steps in, and everything changes.

short_description: The Sling and The Stone™ is an action-adventure game where players craft powerful stones and use a sling to fight enemies, rising from zero to hero in a thrilling journey of revenge and rescue, culminating in a surprising meeting with a greater force.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 - 64-Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 @ 3.7GHz or AMD Athlon X4 880K @4GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 660 2GB or AMD Radeon HD 7850 2GB
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 - 64-Bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-3550 @ 3.40GHz or AMD FX 8150 @ 3.6GHz
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 670 or AMD Radeon R9 270X
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: The Sling and The Stone contains fantasy violence, including battles against demonic enemies using a sling as a weapon. There are themes of revenge, rescue, and spiritual confrontation. The storyline includes intense moments such as the capture of villagers and the hero’s journey to rescue them, but it does not include any depictions of sexual content, drug use, or self-harm. All content is designed to support the emotional and heroic narrative, suitable for teen audiences and above
